title: Fanin of compiled circuits
statement: Let $c$ be a Boolean circuit tree whose maximum fanin is at most $2$. Then every gate in its compiled directed acyclic circuit has at most two inputs, no repeated input vertices, and any NOT gate has exactly one input.
hypotheses_covered: The maximum fanin of $c$ is at most $2$
